name: Yamada Ichiro
source:
A former member of "Dirty Dawg".

He is the eldest son of the Yamada family, having run "Odd Jobs Yamada" whilst raising his two younger brothers. Forward thinking and compassionate, he is a righteous person who cannot abandon anyone in need, though he was once a delinquent known to all in Ikebukuro.
